name: Lightbox
purpose: Full-window viewer for one attachment: a stage that holds the preview and closes on empty space.

values.when: Web, or desktop if the lightbox stays in-window. Sits over Scrim strong-blur.
Desktop, if the lightbox is treated as a dialog window (undecided).

keyboard: Not recorded. Escape is not confirmed. The reference stage also holds prev and next chevrons, which are not in this catalogue.
platform: Desktop presentation is open. Web: overlay.
open: Treating the lightbox as a dialog for the desktop rule needs confirmation. Stage is px-16 pb-8 (a column Stack); the media wrapper stops the stage click from closing. Empty-stage click closes (onClose).
